query:
The Clay & Fire Collective operates on an apparent norm that work in progress is not photographed or shared without the maker's permission. Does this norm apply equally to all members?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Reuben
C. Simone
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Simone, episodic, t6 @2026-04-12T10:37:00) I can take the photos for everyone if people want?? I've gotten pretty good at ceramics photography
[2] (about=Callum, episodic, t8 @2026-05-17T10:11:00) Yes, please do. That was actually on my list -- I wanted someone to photograph the full set laid out before I pack them. Make sure you get the rim detail in natural light if you can. The translucency only shows properly in daylight.
[3] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-15T10:42:00) okay so here's the thing, I've been thinking about doing a group critique session properly in March -- not just a quick chat but a proper round of feedback. I'm wondering if we should do it as the main activity rather than alongside throwing. thoughts? I can set it up properly -- printed notes, the whole thing. 📋
[4] (about=Reuben, episodic, t12 @2026-07-19T10:28:00) I know it is. It means another week's work. But doing it wrong because it's faster is exactly the kind of shortcut that produces mediocre work. The process has to be right before the surface can be right. That's always been my position.
[5] (about=GROUP, said_by=Simone, group-interaction, t6 @2026-04-12T09:43:00) Simone offers to take photos for everyone; Reuben declines (will take own photo); offer stands for others.
agent_answer: D. Yuki — Yuki is the only person listed with no record at all on this matter.
